name: RetroAct
summary: 为生成式交互环境和动作条件世界模型标注的复古游戏环境数据集，含行为、视角、运动轴和控制信息。
summaryEn: An annotated retro-game environment dataset for generative interactive environments and action-conditioned world models, with behavior, camera, motion-axis, and control metadata.
scale: 974 annotated retro game environments; datasets generated from hundreds of environments
scaleZh: 974 个标注复古游戏环境，可从数百环境生成轨迹数据
access: Official repository includes environment annotations, data-generation, training, and evaluation code
accessZh: 官方仓库提供环境标注、数据生成、训练和评测代码
verdict: 用于训练和评测生成式交互世界模型的动作控制环境集
verdictEn: Action-controlled environments for training and evaluating generative interactive world models
wmNote: 控制标注与自动探索回放可直接产生动作到未来观测的训练样本。
wmNoteEn: Control metadata and exploration rollouts directly produce action-to-future-observation training samples.
